description: Read an invoice reference and payment terms out of landed invoice text.
instruction:
Each source document is the text of one invoice.

Read the following:

invoice_ref: the invoice reference exactly as printed.

total_usd: the line total in US dollars, as a number with no currency symbol and no thousands separator.

payment_terms_days: the number of days in the payment terms. If the document does not state payment terms, return the absent sentinel — do not infer a customary value.

Cite the verbatim span you read each value from.
